# Introduction
Classification is a fundamental machine learning task, with applications ranging from image classification, speech recognition, and natural language processing to medical imaging and genomics.
we propose a novel framework, called advocacy learning, which trains a network of subnetworks to compete for a common goal.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Advocacy framework provides a simple and flexible way to incorporate class-conditional representations, and that the competitive nature of the Advocates can improve classification performance.

, by encouraging subnetworks to compete with one another, we can obtain a framework that is more robust to adversarial perturbations, and can provide a more interpretable class-conditional representation.
